_comment: Checked-in digest pins for MUTABLE-TAG images referenced by third-party cluster manifests the kind workflows install (#1289). Knative's own release manifests already digest-pin their own images; the entries below cover the ones that don't: cert-manager (tag-only releases) and net-kourier's envoy sidecar (docker.io/envoyproxy/envoy:v1.31-latest — a floating branch tag, not a fixed release). pin-known-images.sh (NOT apply-pinned-manifest.sh, which does not exist in this repo) rewrites a matching `image: <ref>` line in a downloaded manifest to `image: <repo>@<digest>` before it is ever applied. Resolved with `crane digest <ref>` against the upstream registry at the time noted; bump deliberately (re-resolve + update the digest here) when the pinned tag's release moves, never silently.
